description: Request a playbook revision (e.g., phase transition, scope change). Stores the patch request and resumes the planning VERTEX to produce an updated playbook and plan.
embedding_description: Request a revision to an existing playbook when scope changes, a phase transition occurs, new constraints appear, or the current playbook needs correction. Use to submit a patch request that causes the planning vertex to produce an updated playbook and aligned plan rather than manually rewriting the playbook document yourself.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Patch request stored; planning VERTEX will resume
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The playbook patch has been submitted to the planning VERTEX. The planning model will produce an updated playbook and plan.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Patching a playbook. patch_playbook accepts {playbook_id, patch_description}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: playbook_id does not exist. ConnectionError: thinking model not reachable.
